Name: Animated Crystal Lightning Rods
Author: PixieTJ
Description:
[size=4]Animated crystal spires and clusters for your lightning rods. With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore [/url]version, your lightning rod is replaced with just one animation, but the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] has 12 various types of crystals, so you can mix and match.

Personally, I think harnessing lightning with crystals sounds pretty badass.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/bx7b1p3.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

Thanks to Pathoschild for Content Patcher, PeacefulEnd for Alternative Textures, and spacechase0 for spacecore. Also thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5624?tab=description]JazzyKitty [/url]for the inspiration![/size]

Downloads.Description: CP Version. Only has one animation option and will replace base game lightning rod.
Alternative Textures version. This has 12 different crystals to choose from.
